description: IRA owner born in 1960: start age 75, first required year 2035; nothing required in 2025.
worked:
IRA owner born 1960-02-14; age attained on the 2025 birthday = 2025 - 1960 = 65. Beneficiary is not a spouse more than 10 years younger, so the Uniform Lifetime Table applies.
Required beginning age (IRC 401(a)(9)(C)(v) as amended by SECURE 2.0): born 1960 -> age 75; first distribution year = 1960 + 75 = 2035.
2025 is before 2035 (age 65 is under 75): no required minimum distribution for 2025; required amount 0.
